items.headline: UN COP31 Climate Talks Collapse in Turkey Without Final Agreement
items.summary: The United Nations COP31 climate summit in Antalya, Turkey, concluded without participating nations reaching a final agreement. This marks the first failure of a UN climate conference to reach a consensus in seventeen years, signaling growing political and economic friction over global energy policies.

items.headline: Cybersecurity Giant CrowdStrike Agrees to Acquire Zscaler in $43.9 Billion Deal
items.summary: Cybersecurity firm CrowdStrike announced an agreement to acquire cloud security provider Zscaler in an all-stock transaction valued at $43.9 billion. The landmark deal stands among the largest acquisitions in cybersecurity history, aiming to unify endpoint protection with network security to safeguard emerging AI infrastructure.

items.headline: 2026 Davis Cup Final 8 Starts Today in Bologna
items.summary: The 2026 Davis Cup Final 8, the knockout stage of the men's international team tennis championship, officially begins today in Bologna, Italy. Opening the week-long tournament on Tuesday is a quarterfinal tie between former champions Canada and Czechia as eight top nations battle for the trophy.

items.headline: "The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping" Tops Global Box Office with $225 Million Debut
items.summary: "The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping" earned $225 million globally during its opening weekend, taking the top spot at movie theaters worldwide. Driven by strong international turnout and large-format screenings, the film delivered the studio's largest theatrical debut of the year.
